finalText:
**Redis died and took prod with it.**

`10.0.0.12:6379` refused connections at `02:14:07`. Cache fell back to direct store reads. The store buckled. 173 `TimeoutError: request timed out after 5000ms` followed.

All 13 reconnect attempts failed over 17 minutes. Queue passed its 500 cap at `02:29:12`. `worker-2` hit `JavaScript heap out of memory` at `02:31:44`, exit code 134. Supervisor killed the process group at `02:31:52`.

Last good response was `02:14:03`, line [logs/app.log:181](logs/app.log:181).

Next: find why `10.0.0.12` went down.
